name: WP w3all phpBB
author: axew3

sections.description:
WP w3all phpBB provides free user login and registration integration between a phpBB bulletin board and WordPress CMS.

Wp w3all phpBB integration

Integration cookie based between WordPress and phpBB installed on same and subdomains.

After the setup and initialization of the plugin, WP users will automatically be added into phpBB when they register into WordPress (or in the case of old existent users, when they will login into WordPress), while without using the phpBB extension installed into phpBB, if users are allowed to register in phpBB, they will be added into WordPress when they will visit the WordPress side as logged in or at their first login in WordPress (or install the phpBB extension to add users at same time into WordPress when they register in phpBB). But you could use the plugin just only to transfer users between phpBB and WordPress by activating the plugin as not linked (read the help install page), or to show phpBB posts into a WordPress hosted into another domain

Widgets

  • Login/logout widget (anyway users can login/logout/register on any WordPress or phpBB login form)
  • Last Topic Posts widget(Links, Links and Text, With or Without Avatars), Read/Unread Topics/Posts

Auto Embed phpBB into WordPress Template

WP w3all phpBB is capable of running in iframe mode and automatically embedding phpBB into WordPress template. Setup for the iframe responsive embedded procedure is quick and quite easy!

WP to phpBB and phpBB to WP users

Transfer WP users into your phpBB forums and vice versa

phpBB avatars into WordPress options

Option to use phpBB avatars to replace WP Gravatars

WordPress MUMS ready

It is possible to integrate a WP Multisite network, but linking the same phpBB forum into each subsite

Shortcodes and more options

  • Shortcode to display phpBB posts on WordPress posts/pages as formatted bbcode or plain text
  • Shortcode to display recent phpBB Topics/Posts on WordPress posts/pages
  • Check the list of others available Shortcodes on the Common How To section of the install help page
  • Users Transfer options
  • Check more options and features in the WP admin Settings -> WP_w3all (config page). More documentation can be found at the WP w3all phpBB help page and into inline plugin admin page hints

WordPress phpBB integration without linking users

  • Display phpBB posts and Last Topics Widgets into WordPress posts/pages, also cross domain, without linking users

Help pages

WP w3all phpBB help page with common questions, setup and usage guides, and answers to frequently asked questions to be up and running in minutes are available here:
WP w3all phpBB help page
sections.installation:
• Read this page at axew3.com for the installation guide

Summary

  • Download the WP w3all plugin onto your WP site and activate it.
  • Navigate to the WP w3all settings page underneath the settings tab in your WP admin dashboard.
  • Configure phpBB database connection values. This is REQUIRED.
  • Configure the url of your phpBB forums. This value is REQUIRED.
  • Maybe navigate to the WP w3all tranfer settings page under the settings tab in your WP admin dashboard.
  • So follow the instructions to transfer all of your existing WP users over into phpBB.

Optionally

  • Activate widgets or use shortcodes
  • Detailed instructions at WP phpBB integration help install docs page

sections.changelog:
3.2.1

  • Release Date: 4 Nov 2026
  • Fixed: Remove all old PHP serialize and unserialize instructions across the entire plugin codebase.
  • Important note: If you are using custom files and specifically the custom phpbb_last_topics.php file to display topics, note that you must replace the line $w3phpbbuava = unserialize(W3ALLPHPBBUAVA); with this: $w3phpbbuava = W3ALLPHPBBUAVA;
  • Fixed: Removed all esc_sql() calls and completed the migration of all queries to WordPress MySQL Prepared Statements in class.wp.w3all-phpbb.php so to fix any other possible query related security issue.
  • WP MUMS: The multisite help page has been updated https://www.axew3.com/w3/2017/04/wp_w3all-for-wordpress-ms-mu-multisite-multiuser-network-installations/
  • Update: File common/custom_functions.php adding another simple example for MUMS and little fix others.
  • Fixed: Minor fixes (cleanup).

3.2.0

  • Release Date: 3 Nov 2026
  • Fixed: Error on function w3_check_phpbb_profile_wpnu($username){ Thrown when a password mismatch occurs during an update.
  • Fixed: Switch all queries to the WordPress MySQL Prepared Statements on file class.wp.w3all-phpbb.php.

3.1.9

  • Release Date: 3 Nov 2026
  • Fixed: Error inserting a new user into WP public static function w3_check_phpbb_profile_wpnu($username){.
  • Fixed: More issues into class.wp.w3all-phpbb.php.

3.1.8

  • Release Date: 3 Nov 2026
  • Fixed: Switch queries to the WordPress MySQL Prepared Statements so to fix several functions issues on class.wp.w3all-phpbb.php, as reported by Patchstack.
  • Fixed: Changed public static function w3all_wp_logout($redirect = ”) to be public, so it does not throw an error when called from external functions.
  • Fixed: WordPress Multisite: correctly add phpBB users into subsites when they login or come with valid phpBB credentials.
  • Fixed: File of the working example for the Simple Membership integration /common/custom_login.php
  • Example: So again, to fix the Simple Membership plugin login/logout issues, create the folder /wp-content/plugins/wp-w3all-custom/ and copy two files into it: the new /wp-w3all-phpbb-integration/common/custom_login.php and /wp-w3all-phpbb-integration/common/custom_functions.php. Self-explanatory, simple, working example code is provided within.

3.1.7

  • Release Date: 2 Nov 2026
  • Fixed: Security bugs in the class.wp.w3all-phpbb.php file, as reported by Patchstack.

3.1.6

  • Release Date: 1 Nov 2026
  • Fixed: public static function phpbb_update_profile($user_id, $old_user_data) – current_user_can(‘edit_user’) get Undefined array key 0 in /wp-includes/capabilities.php on line 75 (when user update password) on file class.wp.w3all-phpbb.php.
  • Fixed: private static function create_phpBB_user($wpu, $action = ''){ on file class.wp.w3all-phpbb.php so as to correctly create a user in phpBB when they register in WordPress MU-MS.
  • Fixed: Removed the forced redirect inside the private static function phpBB_user_session_set($wp_user_data){ on file class.wp.w3all-phpbb.php file to avoid redirect conflicts with other plugins.
  • Fixed: function verify_phpbb_credentials(){ for the same above reason so to avoid redirect conflicts with other plugins.
  • Add: common/custom_login.php file to hook into the wp_w3all.php wp_check_password function, thereby easily fixing common login issues with other plugins.
  • Example: To fix the Simple Membership plugin login/logout issues, create the folder /wp-content/plugins/wp-w3all-custom/ and copy two files into it: /wp-w3all-phpbb-integration/common/custom_login.php and /wp-w3all-phpbb-integration/common/custom_functions.php. Self-explanatory, simple, working example code is provided within.

3.1.5

Release Date – 25 Oct, 2026
* Resolved an issue where phpBB Founders (Group ID 5) were incorrectly updated when a profile update was performed in WordPress, as reported in this post: https://wordpress.org/support/topic/profile-update-overwrites-phpbb-user_password-and-user_type/
* Fix: Resolve first-login failure in WordPress after a user updates their password in phpBB and logs out.

1.0.0

  • Release Date – 1 Febrary, 2016*
